title: 시작 버튼
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and Future Bass fusion. A bright, digital synthesizer lead plays a syncopated melody over a heavy sub-bass and a crisp electronic drum kit. The percussion features a sharp snare on the backbeat and rapid hi-hat rolls. Female vocals alternate between rhythmic, breathy delivery in the verses and a powerful, melodic belt in the chorus. A prominent sidechain compression effect creates a pumping sensation on the synth pads. The track features a sudden tempo drop and atmospheric transition before the final chorus. Key: C# Minor. Tempo: 105 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:

[bright digital synth lead, electronic percussion]
